text:
nell: Quick heads-up  opened docs PR to (1) clarify rate/quota headers, (2) add SDK examples across python/js/ruby for quota-aware retries, and (3) fix an outdated Grafana panel link. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8201

harry: Thanks. Which header are we standardizing on? I saw a few names in code: X-Rate-Cap, X-RateLimit, x-rw-rate-info.

sophie: Proposal in PR is x-rw-rate-info as the canonical header (lower-case in examples) and keep legacy aliases. Docs should show a tiny helper that tries canonical then aliases.

harry: Can we include a short ruby snippet too? Some customers use Ruby server agents and we have zero examples for them.

sophie: Yup added ruby example and a short note about parsing values like "1200/min" vs "1200". Here's the ruby snippet I pasted in the thread for reviewers:

```ruby
# ruby: resilient header read
hdr = resp.headers['x-rw-rate-info'] || resp.headers['x-rate-cap'] || resp.headers['x-ratelimit']
if hdr
  qty = hdr.scan(/\d+/).first.to_i
  # normalize missing units -> assume per-minute in examples
end
```

nell: docs-bot CI flagged a broken grafana url in the original page, so I replaced it with the canonical panel id and added a one-line caption describing the "burst_credit_balance" series.

docs-bot: Link-checker: removed broken URL -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/oldpanel/ratelimits flagged as 404. Please confirm replacement: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/newpanel/ratelimits-overview. Re-check will run after commit.

product-ops: Tiny request: add one sentence clarifying burst credits are tracked at the customer_id (account) level, not per-api-key. Had a support ticket where teams with multiple keys were confused. Suggested copy left on the PR.

harry: Good call. I'll fold that line into the migration note (v1.11 -> v1.12) under "Handling 429s & Bursts" and mirror the sentence in the SDK READMEs. Also will add a test in python client that asserts header fallback order.

sophie: I also added a short "Troubleshooting" callout that suggests using the grafana panel to check "burst_credit_balance" and to confirm the header presence in responses when debugging 429s.

nell: Plan: finish docs review + small copy edits today, wait for harry's unit test and docs-bot recheck, then merge. Will include a changelog bullet under "Rate limits & Quotas" for the next minor release.

harry: Quick nit: examples assume unitless -> per-minute. Can we instead show the helper returning a normalized object: {value: 1200, per: 'minute'} so customers can adapt?

sophie: Happy to update examples to return a small struct/object in each SDK example. I'll push that tweak.

docs-bot: Style lint: inline codeblocks missing language tag in ruby example. Suggest adding ```ruby header. Also link re-check scheduled in 10m.

product-ops: If you can add the one-liner about billing aggregation (tiers applied at customer_id) that would reduce churn on support. Thanks.

nell: Added both notes and the updated SDK snippets (python/js/ruby) with normalized return. Pushing final commit now. Will ping when CI passes.

harry: Thanks  will run tests after CI and sign off.

sophie: Awesome  thanks all. Leaving a short merge checklist comment in the PR.
